description: The composite drainage board is an extruded and moulded high-density polyethylene (HDPE) panel, with a concave-convex surface. It is adhered to a layer of geotextile, which filters soil particles and prevents clogging of drainage channels, ensuring unobstructed water flow.
advantages: Made from raw virgin HDPE resin, offering excellent low-temperature resistance, corrosion resistance, durability, high tensile strength, and superior compressive performance.
Nonwoven fabric made of short polypropylene fibers provides stable performance with strong acid and alkali resistance
The HDPE drainage panel and geotextile are adhered with specialized adhesive, ensuring high peel strength and stable pressure.
notFor: The substrate must be clean, flat, and free of standing water.
Backfill immediately after installation; exposure to UV light should not exceed 14 days.
Avoid direct contact of construction machinery with the drainage board.
Mechanical equipment should only be placed when the covering soil thickness exceeds 500mm.

mixing: Drainage boards should be connected using double-sided adhesive tape with a bonding width of no less than 80mm. Ensure proper overlap and sealing of geotextiles and drainage boards.
packaging: Rolled into cylindrical form, packaged with suitable materials
storage: During storage and transportation, keep different types and specifications of products separately. Avoid exposure to sunlight or rain, ensure ventilation, and store at a temperature not exceeding 45°C. Membranes should be stored upright and kept away from acids, alkalis, oils, and organic solvents.
